description: At times, it can be hard to venture outside and enjoy nature. With Signwin's Bird of Paradise, you can create your own personal organic environment! With gorgeous green leaves and a stylish plastic planter, this plant is perfect for home and office. Our artificial plants have a natural botanical allure that can alter the atmosphere of any space. Enjoy nature year-round with Signwin's Bird of Paradise!

Real plants can be a hassle. Constant upkeep to ensure a plant remains healthy can be a waste of energy and resources. With Signwin's Bird of Paradise, no watering is necessary. With stems and branches made from polyester and leaves made from silk, our Bird of Paradise is easy to clean! Simply wipe with a soft cloth whenever necessary.

Our plants come in two pieces. One piece includes the artificial plant, which is attached to the moss base. The second piece is the plastic planter. Simply insert the plant and moss base into the plastic planter for quick assemblage.

We believe in crafting durable decor that stands the test of time. Our in-house design team routinely checks the details of or plants and planters to ensure perfect product quality. We strive to bring customers the most unique and durable synthetic plants. Your Bird of Paradise and accompanying planter will always be perfectly crafted, matching our exacting standards.
